title: Fixed Folded Retaining Wall and Rear Tiebacks
description: One complete newly authored static folded retaining-wall cutaway display. A single continuous full-height zigzag metal-look curtain has complete finite thickness through every fold and capped upper/lower boundaries. Two entire rear walers meet its raised corrugations; two whole descending rods run from the upper waler through collars into independent broad rear anchor blocks. A low common slab exposes the normally concealed rear-side relationship rather than filling it with soil. Unlike the stone-filled wire gabion there is no containment cage or rock fill; unlike the opposed-wall timber flying shore there are no facing bearing plates, cross-span compression beam or central cheek joint. The folded curtain, rear longitudinal wales and one-sided anchoring relation are newly authored together, not transformed prior components. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metre-style Z up, bounds-centred ground sole origin, one architectural model zero scenes. Fixed illustrative layout only: not an interlocking sheet-pile system, geotechnical design or certified tension assembly. No soil pressure, water sealing, pullout resistance, anchoring capacity, load, stress, excavation, installation, structural stability, manufacturing, host fit, building-code or safety capability claimed. No actual retained soil, rigging, animation or interaction.
